title: Critique: micro-intentionality adds nothing once organization explains

statements.text: Terrence Deacon, as Segall reports him, grants that Whitehead explains the difference between life and physics by the organization of enduring societies of occasions, and argues that if organization does the explaining, assuming some micro-intentionality in every component process adds little.

sources.quote: Yet, if specific organizational complexity is what matters, then little explanatory significance is added by the assumption that some level of micro intentionality was suffused throughout all the component processes
